overview.description: TFI International is a North American transportation and logistics company operating less-than-truckload, truckload and logistics businesses in the United States, Canada and Mexico, largely grown through acquisitions.

entities.name: TFI International Inc.
entities.description: TFI International is a North American transportation and logistics company operating less-than-truckload, truckload and logistics businesses in the United States, Canada and Mexico, largely grown through acquisitions.

entities.name: Less-Than-Truckload
entities.description: Pickup, consolidation and delivery of smaller shipments; includes U.S. LTL, Canadian based LTL and Package and Courier.

entities.name: Logistics
entities.description: Asset-light logistics, last-mile delivery, brokerage and warehousing.

entities.name: Truckload
entities.description: Full-load trucking, including specialized and Canadian based conventional truckload.

entities.name: Canadian based Conventional TL
entities.description: Conventional truckload operations based in Canada, which also earn brokerage revenue.

entities.name: Canadian based LTL
entities.description: Less-than-truckload freight operations based in Canada.

entities.name: Package and Courier
entities.description: Package and courier delivery operations within the Less-Than-Truckload segment.

entities.name: Specialized TL
entities.description: Specialized truckload operations, which also earn brokerage revenue; the largest part of the Truckload segment.

entities.name: U.S. LTL
entities.description: Less-than-truckload freight operations in the United States, including Ground with Freight pricing (GFP).
